title: Q-LESSON-COST-SAMPLE-ACT: Act on D1 cost samples
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** grep:seed/worker/src/costsample.js::over_budget
**Status:** closed

LESSONS-1 (2026-11-16): from the failure-mode register of the fleet this org was split from (638 entries, classified by root cause).

D1 rows read were sampled hourly but nothing acted on a breach; the earlier fleet read 8.6 billion rows in a week before anything stopped it.

Path: seed/worker/src/costsample.js

Acceptance: when rows_read_1h exceeds max_rows_read_per_hour the tick skips its non-essential steps for the next hour and the dashboard shows the breach; a test covers the skip.

size: S

**Closing probe:** grep:seed/worker/src/costsample.js::over_budget

**Evidence:** seed/worker/src/costsample.js exports over_budget (latest sample per budget within the hour vs max_rows_read_per_hour); runTick holds a breached tick to COST_ESSENTIAL_STEPS (reconcile, measure, criticality), writes org.cost_breach and a 'cost breach:' line in the tick report; criticality.js treats it as cap_breached (cost_cut only, no IDLE item). Tests: seed/worker/test/tick.test.js 'over_budget reads...' and 'a breached D1 budget skips...'.
